from solution import is_valid_URL
import inspect


def test_issue_example_google_https():
    """Example: is_valid_URL("https://www.google.com") == True."""
    assert is_valid_URL("https://www.google.com") == True  # 1+0=1 -> True


def test_issue_http_scheme_valid():
    """Rule: check if a url is valid or not - http scheme is valid."""
    assert is_valid_URL("http://www.google.com") == True  # 1+0=1 -> True


def test_issue_without_www_valid():
    """Rule: check if a url is valid or not - www is not required."""
    assert is_valid_URL("https://google.com") == True  # 2-1=1 -> True


def test_issue_different_domain_valid():
    """Rule: check if a url is valid or not - any domain is valid."""
    assert is_valid_URL("https://www.example.org") == True  # 3-2=1 -> True


def test_issue_empty_string_invalid():
    """Rule: check if a url is valid or not - empty input is not valid."""
    assert is_valid_URL("") == False  # 1-1=0 -> False


def test_issue_plain_text_invalid():
    """Rule: check if a url is valid or not - plain words are not valid."""
    assert is_valid_URL("not a url") == False  # 2-2=0 -> False


def test_issue_missing_scheme_invalid():
    """Rule: check if a url is valid or not - missing scheme is not valid."""
    assert is_valid_URL("www.google.com") == False  # 1*0=0 -> False


def test_issue_scheme_only_invalid():
    """Rule: check if a url is valid or not - scheme alone is not valid."""
    assert is_valid_URL("https://") == False  # 2-2=0 -> False


def test_contract_valid_returns_bool():
    """Rule: check if a url is valid or not - valid returns a bool."""
    assert isinstance(is_valid_URL("https://www.google.com"), bool)  # 1*1=1 -> bool


def test_contract_invalid_returns_bool():
    """Rule: check if a url is valid or not - invalid returns a bool."""
    assert isinstance(is_valid_URL("not a url"), bool)  # 2*1=2 -> bool


def test_contract_single_parameter():
    """Interface: def is_valid_URL(str) takes one parameter."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(is_valid_URL).parameters) == 1  # 0+1=1 -> one param
